# [nextpyper validate]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-cli} {#commands-validate}

::: {.doc-subject}
Validate a probes file for running NextPyper
:::

::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION}
```bash
nextpyper validate [OPTIONS]
```
:::

::: {.details summary="Full --help output"}

::: {.cli-manpage}

```{python}
#| results: asis
#| source-code: mock
nextpyper validate --help 
# ---
import subprocess

result = subprocess.run(["nextpyper", "validate", "-h"], capture_output=True, text=True)
print(result.stdout)
```

:::

:::

## Options {.doc-parameters}

::: {.doc-definition-items}
<code><span class="doc-parameter-name">-p, &#45;&#45;probes</span><span class="doc-parameter-annotation-sep">:</span> <span class="doc-parameter-annotation">PATH</span></code>
:   **Required.** Path to probes files

<code><span class="doc-parameter-name">&#45;&#45;pattern</span><span class="doc-parameter-annotation-sep">:</span> <span class="doc-parameter-annotation">TEXT</span> <span class="doc-parameter-default-sep op">=</span> <span class="doc-parameter-default">(.*)</span></code>
:   Pattern used to group the probes (RegEx)

<code><span class="doc-parameter-name">&#45;&#45;out_summary</span><span class="doc-parameter-annotation-sep">:</span> <span class="doc-parameter-annotation">PATH</span> <span class="doc-parameter-default-sep op">=</span> <span class="doc-parameter-default"></span></code>
:   Write summary of grouping to this file

<code><span class="doc-parameter-name">&#45;&#45;out_hierarchy</span><span class="doc-parameter-annotation-sep">:</span> <span class="doc-parameter-annotation">PATH</span> <span class="doc-parameter-default-sep op">=</span> <span class="doc-parameter-default"></span></code>
:   Write grouping hierarchy to this file

:::
